title: Apartment Interior Design 107 m² in Madrid | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 107 m² apartment in Madrid: interior design, 3D visualization, technical drawings, custom furniture and turnkey renovation.
h1: Apartment interior design in Madrid, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 107 m²

blocks.text: Apartment interior design in Madrid, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 107 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designed and delivered a project for a 107 m² apartment in Madrid, Spain: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, and a turnkey renovation.

The project included the living room, bedroom, kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, bathroom, and storage areas — all rooms unified by a single concept of materials, color, and lighting.
The kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, shelving, and storage systems were custom-designed and made to the dimensions of the rooms.
Before work began, technical documentation and a detailed cost estimate were prepared, covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting.
The studio then carried out a turnkey renovation of the apartment in Madrid: construction and finishing work, installation of the custom-made furniture, and the final fit-out of the rooms.
Below are 3D visualizations of the project and photos of the renovated apartment with its custom-made furniture.
